title: सीखो: Active और Passive Voice
Seekho: Active aur Passive Voice
Let's Learn: active and passive voice

card: Active: करने वाला पहले: The hunter killed the tiger। Passive: जिस पर काम हुआ वह पहले: The tiger was killed by the hunter। Object कर्ता बनता है, क्रिया be + तीसरा रूप, और by + करने वाला।
Active: karne waala pehle: The hunter killed the tiger. Passive: jis par kaam hua woh pehle: The tiger was killed by the hunter. Object karta banta hai, kriya be + teesra roop, aur by + karne waala.

Active: the doer comes first: The hunter killed the tiger. Passive: the receiver comes first: The tiger was killed by the hunter. The object becomes the subject, the verb is be + 3rd form, then by + the doer.
